## 3. Classification Analysis
The confusion matrix (`confusion_matrix.png`) shows confusion primarily between biomechanically identical exercises (e.g., standard flexion vs resisted flexion). Longer temporal windows are a hypothesis for improving exercise classification, as 2 seconds captures local kinematics perfectly but lacks macroscopic sequence identity.
